text.text_excerpt: This place is consistently good to me. I've always loved papa johns- but they have literally never done me wrong here. Every time my pizza is perfect, and exactly what I asked for. Tonight, my delivery took 20 minutes, way faster than the 40-50 minute estimation. Absolutely never going back to Dominos. Keep doin me proud, guys.

Are there better options for pizza in New Orleans? Of course. There are always better options. But I have ordered from this location over two-dozen times and even lived right next to them, never had a problem. Every order whether take-out or delivery has beed correct and on-time. Order online or with the app, hot pizza at my door in 30-45 minutes every single time. Apparently people don't know how to bring up service issues with store managers. I wish people would give the business a chance to correct the situation instead of just blasting away with poor online reviews.

I'm so ashamed...This Papa John's has literally delivered at least 20 pizzas to me, and I've yet to share my feelings. First things first, Papa...The mobile app is great. It stores my past orders, shows me specials, makes paying a friggin' breeze, and also has Papa Rewards. What is Papa Rewards, you say? It's for lazy folks like me that just want to order a pizza on Sunday, and can sometimes get a free large pizza with up to 3 toppings (or other items for less points) once you hit 25 points ($5 = 1 point)...SO yeah...I may have spent $125 with Papa...a few times. IF you are going to order from Papa John's, just download the app to see what they're working with special-wise and to get them...
